title: Jack White · Archbishop Harold Holmes
description: A full procedural chapel revival leading to the hospital coda. CHIMERA performs the sermon and choruses over the separated accompaniment.

parts.name: Archbishop Harold Holmes
parts.role: Preached verse, sung calls and quiet coda

performance.lyrics: Dear friend, if you wanna feel better, Don't let the devil make you toss this letter. If you've been crossed up by hoodoo, the voodoo, the wizard or the lizard, You got family trouble, man trouble, woman trouble, your life has double trouble. You're looking for a true friend or a true lover, or if you've been living undercover. Well, I'm coming to your town to break it all down, and help you with all of this. I'm looking to help you find bliss. One day, one way, can't miss. I'm here to tear all the walls down. It doesn't matter if it's a large town or a small town. Just like Joshua and the fabled walls of Jericho. I'm here to tear down the institution. God spoke to me, said, listen to me. I anoint you with the power that’ll get them all moving. You agitated, you prayed and meditated, you concentrated on getting elevated. By sundown Monday, you who come will be blessed with a big money blessing. You will be doubted by all the unbelievers and all of the deceivers. But you must tell seven friends. You must first bring seven friends. And don't be selfish and keep this all to yourself. And don't eat shellfish. Hate is trying to take someone else's love for yourself. But I'm here to tell you that love is trying to help someone else. I realize that you have tried and tried and are just about ready to give up. But I got good news for you. God has spoken to my mind and told me to tell you to get moving in the right direction for a change. I'm gonna put you in the fast lane! You need to see me right away, so I can fix this up. You need to see me right away. You need to see me right away, so I can fix this up. You need to see me right about now. God has said he’ll open up the windows of heaven, and pour out a rich and mighty blessing. Not on his town or her town, but your town. Are you ready for the message? I have a special financial blessing that the Lord has placed in your hand. Now I want you to begin using this blessing on the very first day that you can. And if you are suffering a strange sickness, or someone is blocking up all of your success, you need to see me right away, so I can fix this up. Signed and sealed, yours in faith, love and peace. Your friend, Archbishop Harold Holmes.
